question: Why did the error rate go up on 12 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Upstream payments-api is experiencing degraded performance, causing service checkout errors.
why_chain: payments-api is returning HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable) for checkout requests.
This results in timeout errors in the checkout service.
The error rate for service checkout increases from 0.46% to 3.72%.

contributing_factors.description: The increase in error rate is due to the increased load on the payments-api.
why_chain: The request volume for service checkout increased by 12%.
This increased load is causing the payments-api to degrade.
The error rate for service checkout increases from 0.46% to 3.72%.

contributing_factors.description: The increase in error rate is due to the configuration changes in the service checkout.
why_chain: The change in error rate is concentrated in service checkout.
This suggests that the configuration changes in service checkout are the cause.
The error rate for service checkout increases from 0.46% to 3.72%.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a new deployment of the service checkout.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a new deployment of the service checkout.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a data quality issue.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a data quality issue.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in users.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service checkout rose from 0.46% to 3.72% (+717%), with a change point at 2026-03-12T15:15:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.17).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout stayed about the same (849 per 5 min before, 955 per 5 min after, +12%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service checkout rose (220 ms before, 399 ms after, +81%).
Upstream payments-api returning HTTP 503 for checkout (checkout; 2 min after the change; record R014)
checkout: ERROR upstream payments-api timeout after 3 retries (checkout, ap-south; 3 min after the change; record R015)
checkout: ERROR upstream payments-api timeout after 3 retries (checkout, us-east; 8 min after the change; record R016)
checkout: ERROR upstream payments-api timeout after 3 retries (checkout, eu-west; 12 min after the change; record R017)
payments-api status page: investigating degraded performance (checkout; 30 min after the change; record R018)

reasons: ✓ A change event (alerts) lines up in time (2 min after the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff for the checkout service to handle transient failures in the payments-api.
Monitor the payments-api for any future degradation and take preemptive action if needed.
Review and optimize the configuration of the service checkout to reduce error rates.
